messages.subject: geno.image() can I add legends / change layout etc
parts:
Hi, 

I hope that it is alright to ask this here, I've just started using this package and I wanted to make a few graphs for presentation purposes, so I need to add a legend of "red = parent 1, green= parent2" or something to that effect. 
Is this possible I can't find a straightforward way of doing this? 

Also, would like to change the titles of the graph produced but trying to set a title just imposes over the original? 

Hope I can get some help! 

Thanks,
Nathan.

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] geno.image() can I add legends / change layout etc
parts:
Use the function legend() to add a legend. 

Most plot functions in R/qtl should accept xlab, ylab, and main, to change default titles. Which specific plot do you have in mind?

karl
